issues.display_title: Issue #1064: Research on How Old Gothru Processes the “audit” Table
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Comprehensive architectural research on how the legacy GoThru system utilizes and processes the audit database table (moderation.audit connection). This table functions as the core state machine and lifecycle tracker for Google Street View publishing, constellation updates, worker queueing, error retries, and tour statistics.

Key Architectural Findings & State Machine

1. Database Connection & Schema Role

  • Database Model: Defined via App\Class\DatabaseClass::tableAudit() resolving to $this->dbModeration()->table('audit').
  • Primary Keys & Relational Columns:
    • Id (Audit record primary key)
    • moderation_id (Relational link to 0_moderation)
    • user_id (Tour owner / photographer)
    • placeid (Google Place ID)
    • panonr (Panorama count in tour constellation)
    • publish_date, latest_update, update_dates (Serialized timestamps of tour modifications)
    • errors, error_log, error_retry (Failure tracking and retry thresholds)
    • token_info, pano_order (Serialized tokens and sequencing for Street View publishing)
    • published, republished (Job execution lifecycle flags)

2. State Machine Enum & Lifecycle Transitions (published Column)

Value Lifecycle State Triggers & Handling Systems Description
'0' Pending / Queued PublishController::publishTour(), app/Workers/publish_google.php Initial state when a user triggers publishing or updating to Google Street View. Errors and retry counters reset to 0.
'1' In Progress / Worker Picked app/Monitors/googlePublishMonitor.php The cron monitor scans for published = '0' AND errors = '0' AND republished < '3', pushes jobs to RabbitMQ (google_publish_dev / google_publish_live), and immediately transitions status to '1'.
'2' Published / Live on Google PublishClass::publishTour(), PublishClass::upPanoGoogle() When all panoramas are uploaded and connected via the Street View Publish API, status is marked as '2'. Queried by ToursClass::getPublishStatus() to flag tour as published on Google.
'3' Retry Exhausted / Failed Error recovery routines, googlePublishMonitor (republished < 3) Marked when retry attempts exceed limit or critical Street View API failures occur.
'5' Fix On Progress ToursClass::getPublishStatusNew() Special maintenance state indicating constellation geometry or link repair is underway.

3. Core Handlers & Service Responsibilities

  1. App\Http\Controllers\Tours\PublishController:
    • Validates user quota/tokens, serializes token_info and pano_order, initializes audit record to published = '0', republished = '0', errors = '0'.
  2. app/Monitors/googlePublishMonitor.php:
    • Background daemon continuously polling up to 30 unhandled tours in batches of 5 seconds, pushing messages to RabbitMQ, and updating status to published = '1'.
  3. app/Workers/publish_google.php:
    • Worker consumer verifying auditId, handling update_google actions, and managing socket webhooks for error propagation (audit_update_failed).
  4. App\Class\ConstellationClass::addAudit():
    • Synchronizes audit entries during moderation changes, serializes update_dates, recalculates panonr, and manages serialized error logs ($auditId['error_retry'] . '-' . $parametersRaw['error_log']).
  5. App\Class\ToursClass & App\Repositories\Tours\ToursRepository:
    • Aggregates published tour counts, ranks users, calculates photographer stats, and gates tour deletion (cannot delete if published is '0' or '1').

    • If still empty, resolves fallback product name via legacy dictionary $this->billingClass->getProductName()[(string)$productId] or 'Unknown product'.
  2. InvoiceHelper::getChangePlanInfo():
    • Replaced direct access with $prevProductData['display_name'] ?? ($prevProductData['name'] ?? $prevPlanName).
  3. BillingClass::getDisplayName():
    • Replaced unchecked $plans[$plan]['display_name'] accesses with $plans[$plan]['display_name'] ?? ($plans[$plan]['name'] ?? '').
  4. SpaceAddon.php Action:

A functional discrepancy existed between invoice PDF generation triggered immediately after payment (BillingClass::generateInvoiceV2()) versus invoice generation invoked later via the Get Invoice API (InvoiceHelper::generateInvoicePdf()):

    • In BillingClass::generateInvoiceV2(), $data['item']['name'] was previously populated directly with raw $product['name'] (e.g. gov, publish, token_20) rather than resolving the human-readable $displayName / display_name (e.g. Unlock Hosted GoThru Virtual Tour, Unlock Publish Tour, Token 20).
    • Meanwhile, InvoiceHelper::generateInvoicePdf() populated $displayName = $product['display_name'] ?? ($product['name'] ?? '') and resolved token counts (e.g. Token 20).
    • As a result, the receipt PDF received in the user's post-payment confirmation email showed internal product codes (gov, publish), whereas downloading the invoice via GET /invoices/{transid} showed proper customer-facing display names.
  2. Charge Info & Virtual Tour Placeholder Discrepancies:

    • Virtual tour name replacements lacked null-safe token cleaning when metadata was partially missing.

  1. Synchronized Display Name Resolution in BillingClass::generateInvoiceV2():
    • Aligned $displayName resolution with InvoiceHelper:

Root Cause Analysis

In the Virtual Tour detail endpoint (GET /v1/virtualtours/detail/{mid} and GET /v1/virtualtours/detail/{session_id} in App\Http\Controllers\Tours\VirtualToursController):

  1. Misclassification of Basic Account in Pro Tier Array:
    • In VirtualToursController::getVirtualTourDetail(), the check for non-pro subscription was defined as: 
      $pro = !in_array($userDatas['subscribtion'], array(
    '1', '8', '4', '6', '5', '7', '9'
)) ? 1 : 0;
    • Subscription code '7' represents Basic Yearly (SubscriptionCode::BASIC_YEARLY), while '2' represents Basic Monthly.
    • Including '7' in the array caused Basic Yearly users to be treated as $pro == 0 (unlimited free active hosted tours without overlay expiration), bypassing the overlay payment and expiry calculation logic ($daysLeftFoverlay = 0). Consequently, the payed flag ($foverlayPayed) evaluated to false (0) because $daysLeftFoverlay > 0 was required.
  2. Missing Fallback when tour_key is Omitted or Mismatched:
    • When requests called the endpoint without an explicit tour_key parameter or when the tour had a separate key in overlay_audit from initial moderation creation, getOverlayAuditInfo($tourKey, 'hosted') returned empty, failing to find the valid paid audit row.
